svg.title: ONB-S01 - No established setup
svg.desc: Select the public or private path; public readiness is Phase 1. Solid arrows are requests; dashed arrows are paired responses. Grey bars show handling intervals, not duration. Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale. Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified. HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
svg.text: Select the public or private path; public readiness is Phase 1
Existing = documented API / guide; To qualify = logical handoff, no confirmed Spain contract.
opt | Certificate required for the selected purpose; use current evidence
opt | New dataset required by this channel; Spain provisioning and create/confirm contract qualified
opt | Selected private path; only missing setup; all route gates passed
Continue dependent checks only after valid NIF, current action authority and required certificate readiness
ONB-02/03/08 | Unconfirmed evidence holds only dependent work
Private work requires later-phase qualification and authority, route-impact and continuity evidence before
ONB-05/07 | New dataset does not establish public enrolment
Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale.
Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified.
HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
